question: Whether the specific combination of model-specific post-hoc calibration followed by common threshold routing has been previously explored in the literature.
description: If similar methods exist, the novelty of the approach may be limited.
rationale: Establishing novelty is crucial for contribution; we need to search for prior work that combines calibration with threshold-based routing in ensembles.
resolution: No directly matching work was found in the searched literature that combines model-specific post-hoc calibration of diverse models with a unified reliability metric and common thresholds for routing across language and vision benchmarks.
